Method of Attack: Exploitation of a high-severity vulnerability in Veeam Backup & Replication software allowing unauthenticated attackers to steal cleartext credentials and gain remote code execution as SYSTEM
Abusing an unsecured API endpoint to obtain plaintext credentials from the VBR configuration database
Unauthenticated credential dump enabling lateral movement or post-exploitation
Unauthenticated remote code execution turning the vulnerable Veeam instance into a vector for initial access or further compromise
Impacted Systems: Veeam Backup & Replication (VBR) software versions V11 and V12 and all older versions
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated access via unsecured API endpoint
External network access to VBR servers on TCP port 9401
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code published on Github by Horizon3
Video demo of PoC exploit by Huntress Labs
